project_id.description: Existing project that hosts the integration and supplies its metrics and logs.

validation.error_message: Use a GCP project ID, not its display name or project number.

deployment_region.description: Region for Cloud Run and the customer-owned Infrastructure Manager bootstrap deployment.

validation.error_message: Use a regional location such as us-central1.

integration_account_id.description: UUID returned when the GCP agent integration is created in SigNoz.

validation.error_message: Use the lowercase integration account UUID returned by SigNoz.

signoz_api_url.description: SigNoz API URL used for agent check-in.

validation.error_message: The SigNoz API URL must use HTTPS.

ingestion_url.description: SigNoz ingestion URL used by the Agent and Collector.

validation.error_message: The ingestion URL must use HTTPS.

agent_image.description: Agent image, pinned to a release tag or digest.

collector_image.description: Contrib Collector image used for bootstrap and Agent revisions. Enable logs only with a build containing the Pub/Sub push receiver.

validation.error_message: Provide a contrib Collector image containing nop receiver/exporter and the health_check extension.

api_secret_id.description: Existing API-key secret in project_id, containing JSON with an api_key field and labeled managed-by=signoz. Created and populated outside Terraform.

validation.error_message: Provide a secret ID in the deployment project, using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

api_secret_version.description: Existing API-key version. Use the numeric version returned when uploading the key; latest is available for manual setup.

validation.error_message: Use a positive numeric secret version or latest.

ingestion_secret_id.description: Existing plain-text ingestion-key secret in project_id, labeled managed-by=signoz. Created and populated outside Terraform.

validation.error_message: Provide a secret ID in the deployment project, using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

ingestion_secret_version.description: Existing ingestion-key version. Use the numeric version returned when uploading the key; latest is available for manual setup.

validation.error_message: Use a positive numeric secret version or latest.
The check-in interval must be a whole number of at least 30 seconds.

agent_cpu.description: Cloud Run CPU limit for the Agent. Customer changes are made through bootstrap.

validation.error_message: Choose a Cloud Run CPU limit of 1, 2, 4, 6, or 8.

agent_memory.description: Cloud Run memory limit for the Agent. Must be compatible with agent_cpu.

collector_cpu.description: Initial Collector CPU limit, used only at service creation. Later sizing changes are made on Cloud Run and preserved by the Agent.

validation.error_message: Choose a Cloud Run CPU limit of 1, 2, 4, 6, or 8.

collector_memory.description: Initial Collector memory limit, used only at service creation. Must be compatible with collector_cpu.
